logic_errors.issue: The Overdue filter reduces dueAt timestamps to a civil day and compares only against today. An incomplete task due at 2026-10-26T01:00:00Z is excluded at 2026-10-26T12:00:00Z in Asia/Jakarta even though its exact deadline has passed. This contradicts the plan's separate timestamp deadline semantics; date-only values may use end-of-day but timestamps must not silently do so.
logic_errors.evidence: Executed the actual view-model source in memory using node:module stripTypeScriptTypes: deadlineAlreadyPassed=true, overdueMatches=0 for that example.
logic_errors.recommendation: Use exact instant comparison for valid dueAt, civil-day comparison for dueOn, retain completed exclusion, and add a same-day elapsed timestamp regression.

logic_errors.issue: Whitespace-only task names are accepted and marked untitled by normalization, but taskTitle substitutes only the exact empty string. Such a task produces a visually blank and unnamed detail-opening button instead of a usable untitled title. Existing UI tests explicitly preserve this behavior rather than protecting usability.
logic_errors.evidence: Executed taskTitle on name='   ': whitespaceTitleHasVisibleText=false. This is an accepted input case, not a claim that the current remote catalog contains it.
logic_errors.recommendation: Provide a nonblank display placeholder including the GID for whitespace-only names while preserving canonical raw names in source data and JSON exports.
